unlaunched_inventory.calculation_note: UPPER: elapsed_days x sustained_consistent_rate (production never throttled down). LOWER: elapsed_days x realized_peak deployment rate, used as a proxy for production throttled to track what could actually ship -- NOT a claimed production-capacity figure. Both are illustrative modeled scenarios, not disclosed production figures; real output was somewhere in this range, most likely.
